ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low macro-level ratio; predominantly low-intensity (black) pixels across >95% of the visible ventral surface with minimal high-intensity (white) regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant solid low-intensity pigmentation; high-contrast white contiguous blobs are localized exclusively at the distal tips of both lobes. A single small, irregular medium-intensity (gray/white) patch is visible near the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated V-shaped depression at approximately 65 degrees with a well-defined vertex at the central axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations extracted along the entire trailing edge boundary; multiple jagged peaks and deep valleys are most pronounced on the outer lateral sections of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Broad convex curvature from the median notch extending to the distal tips, modulated by secondary micro-level topographical serrations.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense spatial clusters of high-intensity white pixels localized at the distal edges of both the left and right fluke lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive white scarring and irregular calcification/encrustation patterns present at the distal tips of both fluke lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Irregular light-colored pixel patch located on the ventral surface immediately to the left of the median notch vertex.
